answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in violet, checked in saffron, and tundra makes public each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 15 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2329 identities would post 1420 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
